context: Assess the substance of review.md against the supplied packet. Equivalent wording is acceptable. Award for grounded reasoning, not particular headings or keywords. No execution of recorded commands is needed.

checklist.name: revision_binding
checklist.description: Identifies that unit-41 tested aaaa… while candidate.json selects bbbb… and records a behavior change afterward; cites both files/fields.

checklist.name: scope_of_proof
checklist.description: Credits the 18 passing tests for the older revision but treats current-candidate verification/readiness as incomplete or unsupported.

checklist.name: minimal_resolution
checklist.description: Requests the relevant suite on the selected candidate and a run record bound to that revision; does not propose an unrelated rewrite or require deployment.

checklist.name: calibrated_conclusion
checklist.description: Does not claim the new code is known broken, tests failed, or the author lied merely because current evidence is missing.
